description: Add a person who already has a Last Price account to your workspace with a role. Only an owner can grant owner. Needs an API key sent as x-api-key that holds the team:admin scope, made by someone who is still an owner or admin of the workspace; a token or any other key is refused. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

user_id.description: The person's user id: user_id on a list_team_members result.

name: add_team_member
